task: Phase 2d plan Task 5 -- the easy rung: the positive control, and the gate
what_this_rung_is_and_is_not: The easy rung's l and Delta were chosen BY US for detectability. It is a demonstration and a
resolution floor and its numbers are never quoted as a magnitude. A retune after seeing the
result is a NEW RUNG WITH A NEW NAME, never an edit -- editing in place loses the record of
what was tried and converts a control into a tuned result.
And the standing limitation is unchanged: the field's coherence is a construction parameter,
2d does not close D1, and the named closer is a spike on a real gridded product.

instrument.field: metamer.bench.fields, 32 x 12, boundary at index 16, step w = 0, family change
instrument.threads: threadpool_limits(1), the setting every 2d rate was measured under
note_on_this_block: A recorded measurement is a current claim only while the configuration that produced it
is. If a named default above has moved, the artifact's check FAILS rather than the number

cost_expected.components: cold run 1.0 + two-pass 1.016 + the N2 map 4.0 (run_arms fits COLD, WARM, N1, N2)
the_self_arm_is_extra_and_is_not_priced_: Task 0 measured self collapsing to 4-6% of cold, so it is roughly 5% of one arm.
If it costs a full arm, that is reading E5's refutation and not a budget surprise.

readings.name: the interior null at the easy rung -- E6's third row, the sub-phase's gate
prediction_is_cited_not_restated: Task 2 committed this prediction before any rung ran and it is NOT re-predicted here:
'THE INTERIOR NULL'S PREDICTION IS COMMITTED AND UNRUN: IT DOES NOT FIRE.' _family() is a
pure indicator, so the true family is constant within a regime and a misclassification
profile has no slope to find. A measurement stated twice has one copy deleted.

refuted_from_below.when: not available -- the floor IS the bottom of this quantity
reading: E6's table carries a dash here for the same reason. A one-sided clause is correct when the
quantity is one-sided; writing a lower clause to make the pair look symmetric would be a
clause that cannot fire.

refuted_from_above.when: the null returns a width -- at_floor false
reading: STOP. run_rung computes the null FIRST and never computes the widths, and require_clean
raises. The profile then separates two causes and cells alone cannot:
A BAND at the null line -- the estimator is reading the field's own structure. E6's third
row: every smear number on every rung is contaminated, and the estimator is the subject.
A FLAT HIGH LINE -- the baseline disagreement rate is itself above a half, which is a
statement about selection between two Matern families at N = 630 and invalidates the
SUBJECT rather than the estimator. This is what the capped smoke run showed: 26.0 cells,
profile flat at 1.0 at every index, caused by matern12 never reaching OK at max_iter = 8.
ACTION either way: report and stop. Do not proceed to the middle rung.

readings.name: the warm arm's smear width at the easy rung -- the positive control
prediction: Between 2 and 6 fine cells, and ONE-SIDED, on the region-A side of the boundary.
The mechanism, which is geometry rather than expectation: the boundary index is 16 and 16
is itself a coarse index, so coarse row 16 is the FIRST ROW OF REGION B and is the nearest
coarse source for rows 13, 14 and 15 of region A -- 1 to 3 cells away against 5 to 7 from
row 8. Those rows warm-start from the wrong family. Row 12 is equidistant and is a
tie-break. On the B side rows 17-23 source from row 16, their own regime, so there is no
pull at all. Three cells, plus at most the tie, plus the estimator's own resolution.

refuted_from_below.when: the width is at the 1-cell floor
reading: The instrument cannot resolve the artifact at ANY contrast -- this rung was built to be
the easiest case there is. The middle rung's null would then be uninterpretable, and
THAT IS 2d's FINDING, reported rather than worked around by widening the contrast until
something appears.
Before concluding it, read the profile: the majority rule is blind to a smear that never
carries a cell past a half (30% over six cells reads at the floor), and a one-sided
artifact displaced by one cell misses the seed pair (15, 16) and reports 0.
ACTION: report. A retune is a new rung with a new name.

refuted_from_above.when: the width exceeds 8 fine cells -- one coarse spacing
reading: Cells whose nearest coarse source is on their OWN side of the step are misclassifying, so
the profile is measuring something other than cross-boundary contamination -- most likely
the field's own structure, which is E6's third row arriving at the smear line rather than
at the null line.
THE CLAUSE IS NOT STATED AT THE SPIRAL REACH, DELIBERATELY. The reach is 32 fine cells and
N_NORMAL is 32, so Task 2 measured that the reach refusal CANNOT FIRE on this geometry. A
clause there would be unfireable, and an unfireable clause is not a prediction.

readings.name: the warm width against the N2 floor -- the interpretable quantity
prediction: warm > n2, an ORDERING, because hysteresis is a directional bias toward the neighbour's
answer and N2 carries the same per-cell distance in a random direction. The ordering is
predicted rather than banded because there IS an ordering claimed here.
N2's own width is expected to be ABOVE the floor and that is not a defect: N2's
displacement is matched per cell to that cell's warm/cold distance, which is largest
exactly where the warm source is from the other regime -- near the boundary. That is the
whole argument for the arm.
COLD'S WIDTH IS A THIRD NUMBER AND IS A FLOOR FOR NEITHER. A cold arm has no warm start,
so its width is misclassification near the boundary and nothing else; on the clean smoke
run it was 13.0 against warm's 14.0, and reading warm's 14.0 as the artifact would have
been reading 13.0 of something else. The reading is warm against N2, never against zero.

reading: No directional component at this contrast: the sensitivity is to START DISTANCE and not to
direction, which is the audit's four-reading-table row 2 -- benign, NOT hysteresis. A
finding, not a failure, and it makes the middle rung's number a distance effect.
Same mechanism cap as E2's upper clause: no point is warm-started from beyond its nearest
coarse source while every coarse fit is OK, so a difference wider than one coarse spacing
is the estimator rather than the artifact.

readings.name: the warm-start saving at the easy rung, in iterations -- E6's monotonicity, first point
prediction: SMALL, and possibly zero or negative. Band [-5%, +15%] on the NET saving.
The mechanism is D1's 2026-08-30 reattribution, which is a measurement and not a guess:
2c's saving tracks COLD-START DIFFICULTY rather than coherence -- 28.27 iterations/point
gave +7.80%, 35.32 gave +31.73%, 40.79 gave +42.28%, and its random arm (a distant
converged optimum, carrying no proximity information) tracks the same curve. 2d's field
runs at 24.4 iterations/point at N = 630, BELOW 2c's shortest fixture. The amendment says
so in as many words: 'a near-zero saving there is what this curve predicts.'
IT IS A BAND AND NOT AN ORDERING because there is one rung here. E6's monotonicity is an
ordering over three rungs and it closes at Task 7; committing an ordering at one point
would be a prediction in a form the quantity cannot take.
reported_twice_and_both_named: pass 2 against cold, and (pass 1 + pass 2) against cold. D11 gives pass 1 its own store, so
a saving read off pass 2 alone charges the coarse fits to nobody. On this geometry pass 1
is 8 points of 384 -- 1/48, not the 1/64 the budget's arithmetic assumed.

refuted_from_above.when: the net saving reaches +30%, section 11.2's threshold
reading: The difficulty explanation fails on this field: a saving that large at 24.4 cold
iterations per point would put 2d's point far off 2c's curve, and the reattribution's
claim that the climb is difficulty rather than coherence would need re-examining.
A FINDING ABOUT WHAT DRIVES THE SAVING, not an error. Report it; do not re-price D1.

refuted_from_below.when: the net saving is below -5% -- warm materially COSTS MORE than cold
reading: Suspect the instrument before the mechanism, and the run carries the check that separates
them: the WARM arm computed by run_arms must reproduce pass 2's store cell by cell. If it
does not, the rebuilt warm array is not the one pass 2 used and every arm in this report
is keyed to a start no run made. If it does, the warm start is genuinely hurting at this
difficulty, which is a finding about warm-starting an easy field.

and_an_ordering_clause_that_IS_predicted.claim: the warm saving is strictly below the self saving on THIS field
reading: E6's upper clause: the warm arm is reading its own answer back -- the source map handing
points their own optimum. The run also carries the structural half, which says which:
no FINE point may source itself (D12 gives a coarse point itself and nobody else), read
off SourceMap.radius with no fits at all.

readings.name: N1's cost against cold's, and the self arm as the void control
prediction: N1/cold iterations in [1.0000, 1.0026]. Task 0 measured 1.0017 on average and never outside
that band, over six repeats across two runs: N1_EPSILON = 6.055e-06 is a displacement the
optimizer cannot distinguish from zero, so N1 starts where cold starts.
THE READING IS IN ITERATIONS. The plan says 'cost within the spread Task 0 measured' and
Task 0's spread is an iteration ratio; this box's wall clock has been shown three times not
to hold still, most recently at 15% across one day on a bit-identical fixture.
THE RATIO IS TAKEN OVER CELLS OK IN BOTH ARMS. Two totals over two cell sets are totals of
different things, and one unshared cell of a 384-point field moves the reading across a
band this narrow.
THE SELF ARM IS THE POSITIVE CONTROL: self/cold is predicted at or below 0.25, and Task 0
measured 0.04-0.06 on its own fixture.

reading: The perturbation is doing something other than displacing the start, and 2c's four-reading
table is affected: its first row reads a non-zero N1 as 'the surface is deciding'.
N1 costs LESS than cold, which would mean the optimizer's first step is not scale-
invariant the way fd_step assumes -- a finding about optimize_series, not about 2d.
The instrument has not been shown able to tell two arms apart by cost. 'N1 costs what cold
costs' is then byte-identical to 'every arm silently ran cold' and to 'the iteration
counter is not moving'. NO COST READING IN THIS RUN MAY BE QUOTED. Task 0's own rule.

readings.name: the free cross-checks, which gate rather than annotate
prediction: All four pass. None is a new measurement: each is a comparison of two paths to one
quantity that the run already produced.

checks.name: the map's COLD arm reproduces the cold run's store, cell by cell
checks.expected: identical, because iterations are deterministic and it is the same 384 fits
if_it_fails: run's tiled fit phase does different work from a bare fit. That is Task 0's third
reading -- open since 2026-08-30 and owned by Task 4 -- answering itself, and it
re-bases the budget, whose unit is measured on fit and spent on run.
It replaces the assertion Task 6 lost when its audit became this rung's own map.

checks.name: the map's WARM arm reproduces pass 2's store, cell by cell
if_it_fails: STOP. The driver's rebuilt warm array is not the one pass 2 used, and N1 and N2 are
displacements FROM that array -- so every arm in this report is keyed to a start no
run made. It would not look like an error. It would look like a smear.

checks.name: criterion 17's committed figure reproduces off this run's cold store
checks.expected: 2340 iterations over the 96-point subgrid, mean 24.375, min-max 21-28, 287 of 288 cells OK
if_it_fails: Either the field is not the fixture criterion 17 measured -- seed, geometry, draw method
or candidate set has moved -- or run's fit phase differs from core.fit's, which is the
check above. The two are told apart by which of them fails.

checks.name: no fine point sources itself
checks.expected: zero, by D12 -- a coarse point's source is itself and nobody else's is
if_it_fails: The source map is handing fine points their own optimum, which 2c measured returns the
cold answer at 99.58% agreement. It would read as a spectacular saving.

the_fixture_fact_that_would_void_everyth: At a low iteration cap matern12 never reaches OK and the selection axis collapses to white
everywhere: n_valid is 1 and no selection is being made. This run uses the DEFAULT cap of 200
and asserts that both correlated candidates win somewhere before any width is read. A width
measured on a degenerate selection axis is a statement about the cap.
what_this_run_does_not_establish: No magnitude. 2d quotes none: the plausibility rung is not constructible, the middle rung is
ours to choose, and this one was built to fire.
Nothing about real altimetry. Every number is measured on a field whose coherence and contrast
are construction parameters, at a cold difficulty (24.4 iterations/point) BELOW 2c's field at
its shortest record length -- so every 2d saving is a saving at lower difficulty than D1's
